prompt:
Fix snippets/cart-line-item.liquid so that it renders one cart line as a list item. Inputs (all top-level, no section.settings): - `item` (object, always present) with exactly three keys, all always present: - `item.title`: string, never null - `item.variant_title`: string or null - `item.quantity`: integer >= 1 Output is exactly one element with no surrounding whitespace or newlines: `
  • TITLE[VARIANT]Qty: N
    • ` Rules: - TITLE is `item.title`, HTML-escaped with Liquid's `escape` filter. - [VARIANT] is `VARIANT`, where VARIANT is `item.variant_title` HTML-escaped. Output it only when `item.variant_title` is not null, not the empty string and not exactly equal to `Default Title`. The comparison is case-sensitive and whole-string, so for example `Default Title Bundle` is still shown. In every other case [VARIANT] is omitted entirely. - N is `item.quantity` printed as an integer. - Do not trim any values and do not add whitespace between the elements. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/cart-line-item.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
